next_search_hypothesis: The iter_001 reward design has good action coverage (uses actions 1,2,3) and progress-delta guidance, but the success bonus fires in non-terminal states (proxy-success farming) and the crash penalty heuristic misclassifies normal flight as crashes. The next edit should: (1) Fix the crash penalty to only apply on actual environment termination (game_over or out-of-bounds), not on leg contact state during flight. (2) Make the success bonus truly terminal-aligned: only pay when the episode terminates with both legs contact, near pad (distance < 0.15), low vertical speed (abs(vy) < 0.5), and upright (abs(angle) < 0.2). Use a success_flag to ensure one-shot payment. (3) Keep the progress-delta reward (capped at +5 per step) and near-pad bonus (+1.0 when distance < 0.3 and abs(vy) < 0.5) as non-terminal guidance. (4) Increase main engine bonus to +0.5 when distance > 0.5 to provide meaningful incentive for approaching the pad. (5) Add diagnostics for success_flag and objective_bonus to enable post-training audits. The expected behavior change is: success_like_terminal_rate increases from 0.0 to >0.0, unsafe_terminal_rate decreases from 1.0 to <1.0, and the success bonus becomes a one-shot terminal event (success_flag_mean <= 1.2).
